description: Global Seasonal Sentinel-1 Interferometric Coherence and Backscatter Data Set is an open dataset on Amazon S3 listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS, a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3 under the section "infrastructure", published or maintained by Earth Big Data LLC. This data set is the first-of-its-kind spatial representation of multi-seasonal, global SAR repeat-pass interferometric coherence and backscatter signatures. Global coverage comprises all land masses and ice sheets from 82 degrees northern to 79 degrees southern latitude. Coverage: as stated on the registry page. The registry lists it under the tag infrastructure and hosts it on Amazon S3. Update frequency: The data set covers the time period from 1-Dec-2019 to 30-Nov-2020. No updates are currently produced. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (as given on the registry page). Caveats: this record was written from the registry page, which was read; the data on S3 were not opened, the licence text was shortened, and the description may lag the source. It can support data-driven infrastructure planning and analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws.
